3000: Loop a resistance band around the ball of your front foot.
Hold the band ends and stand tall.
Place the front heel on the floor with the toes lifted.
Pull the band so your toes draw toward you and lean slightly forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds with a comfortable stretch.
3001: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and toes slightly out.
Brace your core and lift your chest.
Bend at the hips and knees to lower into a squat.
Push your knees out so they follow the line of your toes.
Go down as deep as feels controlled.
Drive up through your whole foot to stand.
3002: Kneel and place one hand under your shoulder, with the other arm behind your back.
Spread your knees a bit wider for balance.
Keep a straight line from your head to your knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Press back up without twisting your hips.
3004: Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Start walking at a pace faster than a stroll.
Swing your arms naturally with elbows bent.
Land on your heel and roll through to your toes.
Keep breathing steadily and stay able to talk.
3006: Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Wrap the resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees.
Place your hands on the sides of the chair or bench for support.
Engage your abductors (outer thigh muscles) and slowly push your knees apart, against the resistance of the band.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly bring your knees back together.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3007: Attach the resistance band to a sturdy anchor point and secure it around your ankle.
Stand facing the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Keeping your core engaged and your upper body stable, extend your leg straight out in front of you.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly return your leg to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
3009: Stand at the bottom of a staircase, standing tall.
Step up with one foot, placing your whole foot on the step.
Press through your heel and bring the other foot up.
Keep your torso upright and swing your arms naturally.
Continue at a steady pace and alternate the leading leg.
3010: Lie flat on a bench with your head at one end and your feet on the floor.
Hold the EZ barbell with a pronated grip (palms facing away from you) and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms straight above your chest, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the barbell in an arc motion behind your head, maintaining the slight bend in your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then return the barbell to the starting position by reversing the arc motion.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3011: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Place your hands on the bench slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Position your feet on the ground, hip-width apart.
Lower your chest towards the bench, keeping your elbows tucked in.
As you lower, retract your shoulder blades, squeezing your scapulae together.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3012: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended in front of you.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows and retracting your shoulder blades, as if you are trying to squeeze a pencil between them.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your hands to extend your elbows and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3013: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your arms by your sides, palms facing down.
Engage your glutes and core, then lift your hips off the ground until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your glutes.
Slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3016: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3017: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your chest up.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Pull the barbell towards your upper abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3018: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Rise up onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause at the top for a second.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.
Hold a wall for balance if needed.
3019: Position yourself under a bar or a sturdy horizontal surface that is at chest height.
Grab the bar or surface with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Pull your chest towards the bar or surface by squeezing your shoulder blades together and bending your elbows.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar or surface.
Lower yourself back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3021: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your body.
As you lower, squeeze your shoulder blades together and push your chest forward.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3023: Lie on your back with a band around your lower leg anchored to the side.
Bend your knees with your feet on the floor.
Rotate your lower leg outward against the band, turning the hip inward.
Complete your reps and switch legs.
3030: Rest a barbell across your upper back and step one foot forward.
Stand with a long stride and your torso upright.
Bend both knees and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front heel down and your front knee over your foot.
Press through the front foot to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
3034: Start on hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Lift one leg with the knee bent at 90 degrees.
Push the sole of your foot toward the ceiling and squeeze your glute.
Lower slowly without arching your back.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
3035: Start on hands and knees with a flat back.
Keep your knee bent at about 90 degrees.
Lift the bent leg out to the side to hip height.
Squeeze your outer hip at the top without rotating your torso.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
3037: Stand tall with your arms bent at your sides.
Jog on the spot or move forward slowly.
Kick each heel up toward your glute.
Stay on the balls of your feet and keep your knees pointing down.
3040: Attach a bar to a high pulley and face away from the machine.
Hold the bar behind your head with elbows pointing forward.
Step forward and stagger your feet.
Extend your arms to press the bar overhead.
Lower slowly back and keep your elbows in place.
3048: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and strap it to your outer ankle.
Stand sideways to the machine and hold a support.
Keep your torso upright and your standing leg slightly bent.
Lift the cuffed leg out to the side.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps and switch legs.
3068: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold an end in each hand.
Stand tall with elbows by your sides.
Curl the rope up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
3075: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand pressed together over your chest.
Keep your palms facing each other.
Lower the dumbbells to your chest with your elbows tucked.
Press back up while keeping the weights touching.
3083: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang by your sides, palms forward.
Curl the weights up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top and keep elbows pinned.
3084: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arm on the pad.
Hold a dumbbell with your palm facing up.
Curl the weight toward your shoulder.
Lower slowly until nearly straight, then switch arms.
3086: Stand tall with your hands behind your head.
Lift one knee up and across your body.
Twist your torso to meet the knee with the opposite elbow.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.
Keep your chest lifted and breathe evenly.
3088: Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders and sink into a deep squat.
Place your fingertips on the floor between your feet.
Jump forward and up, swinging your arms.
Land softly back in the squat.
Reset and hop again right away.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
3091: Skip forward, driving one knee up high.
Hop lightly on the other foot.
Swing the opposite arm forward with each knee.
Alternate legs in a smooth rhythm.
Keep your chest up and land softly.
3092: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up through your feet to stand.
Lift one knee toward your chest as you reach the top.
Lower the foot and go back into the squat.
3094: Stand with your feet together and your arms at your sides.
Jump your feet apart as you swing your arms overhead.
Jump back to the start position.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
3095: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee.
Push off hard to leap sideways.
Land on the opposite foot and bend to absorb the impact.
Hold the landing for a second to stay balanced.
Keep your chest up and your knee over your toes.
3096: Sit with your chest against the pad and grab the narrow handles.
Pull one handle back, driving your elbow behind you.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end.
Return slowly and pull with the other arm.
Alternate sides and keep your torso still.
